# A01-S89: Project synopsis

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

I had a good time playing here on Saturday, and have written a draft for the synopsis. It's ready for you, but not for the rest of the company ;-)

I have deliberately refrained from specifying your contribution further than as co-curator/sender. Partly I think it's more fun to define it when we can compare both synopses. Moreover, it's always best to determine your own role. I look forward to hearing what you think of my proposal, how you yourself might want to be involved, and to continue working on it in integration with your own proposal.

[…]
